title: Relationship Manager - Corporate Banking
description:
Job Vacancy – **Relationship Manager – Corporate Banking**

**Location: Dubai / Kochi, Kerala**  
Company: Amana Finanz  
Employment Type: Full-Time | Work from Office  
**Salary: Current Salary + 30% Hike**

Job Description

Amana Finanz, a UAE-based corporate banking services partner, is looking for a motivated and experienced Corporate Banking / SME Relationship Manager with a strong background in corporate banking. Candidates with experience at ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, or other reputed international banks are preferred.

The candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining client relationships, developing business opportunities, understanding corporate clients' financial requirements, and facilitating suitable corporate banking solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective corporate and SME clients.
* Identify potential customers and generate new business opportunities.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable corporate banking solutions.
* Handle client enquiries professionally and maintain long-term business relationships.
* Coordinate with internal teams and banking partners to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Follow up on leads and convert prospects into clients.
* Maintain accurate client records and regular follow-up reports.
* Demonstrate strong practical knowledge of Letters of Credit (LC), Trust Receipts (TR), bank guarantees, and working capital assessment.
* Understand corporate banking products, trade finance facilities, and SME financing requirements.
* Assess client business requirements and coordinate with relevant banking teams regarding suitable facilities.
* Work towards business development targets and maintain strong client relationships.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Previous experience in the banking sector is mandatory.
* Experience in Corporate Banking or SME Banking at ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, or another reputed bank is mandatory.
* Strong knowledge of corporate banking products and services.
* Practical knowledge of LC, TR, bank guarantees, and working capital assessment.
* Excellent client relationship management and business development skills.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to identify customer requirements and generate qualified business leads.
* Strong networking, follow-up, and client-handling skills.
* Target-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in Relationship Management, Corporate Banking, Business Banking, or SME Banking.
* Experience handling business owners, entrepreneurs, corporate clients, and SMEs.
* An established client network and a proven track record of achieving business targets.
* Experience in trade finance, working capital facilities, and corporate financial solutions.
* Experience with reputed domestic or international banks.

Compensation

Salary will be based on the candidate's **current salary, with an expected hike of 30%**, subject to discussion and suitability.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with their current salary, expected salary, notice period, and preferred work location (Dubai or Kochi).

Work Location: In person

title: Telesales Supervisor
description:
Telesales Supervisor

**Company:** KDC Chits Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Kochi / Ernakulam, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Sales & Marketing  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years

Job Summary

KDC Chits Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive and target-driven **Telesales Supervisor** to manage and motivate our telesales team. The ideal candidate should have strong team management skills, experience in sales conversion, and the ability to monitor calling performance and achieve sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Supervise, guide, and motivate telesales executives to achieve daily and monthly sales targets.
* Allocate leads and monitor daily calling activities, follow-ups, bookings, and customer conversions.
* Track individual and team performance and prepare daily sales reports.
* Monitor call quality, communication standards, and adherence to approved sales scripts.
* Train team members in product knowledge, customer handling, objection handling, and sales techniques.
* Ensure timely follow-up of leads and improve lead-to-customer conversion rates.
* Identify underperforming employees and implement performance improvement plans.
* Coordinate with the Sales Manager and Operations Team for customer onboarding and successful joining.
* Maintain accurate sales trackers, CRM records, and MIS reports.
* Ensure transparent customer communication and compliance with company policies.
* Escalate customer complaints and operational issues to the concerned departments.

Requirements

* 2–5 years of experience in telesales, telemarketing, or sales team supervision.
* Previous experience managing a target-driven sales or telecalling team is preferred.
* Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills.
* Excellent Malayalam communication skills; English proficiency is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, CRM tools, and sales reporting.
* Ability to analyse performance, solve problems, and achieve targets.
* Experience in chit funds, NBFCs, banking, insurance, or financial services will be an added advantage.
* Bachelor's degree preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Daily, weekly, and monthly sales target achievement.
* Team conversion rate and customer joining rate.
* Productive calls and follow-up completion.
* Lead management and pending lead closure.
* Call quality and customer satisfaction.
* Team productivity, attendance, and discipline.
* Accuracy and timely submission of sales reports.

Salary and Benefits

Salary will be based on experience and skills. Performance-based incentives may be provided according to company policy.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed by submitting their updated resume.

**Join KDC Chits Pvt. Ltd. and contribute to building a productive, customer-focused telesales team.**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

* Cell phone reimbursement

title: Senior Officer, Branch Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions across ~500 branches in the country. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits (incl. structured solutions for NRI), investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage.

**Job Purpose**

* To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance by acquiring and engaging with DBS clients having an AUM => INR 1 million through “need-based approach” and ensure client coverage and product penetration through cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage & maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through pro-active client engagement & relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service and Distribution and Product team

**Key Accountabilities**

* Acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch location areas to Treasures segment.
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth
* Ensure proper implementation & execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new- to- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on-boarding.
Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.  

**Job Duties & responsibilities**

* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM => INR 1 M
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.

**Required Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products.

* Graduate(10+2+3).

title: Manager - Business Analysis
description:
**Job Title \- Manager – Business Analysis \- ACS Song**

**Management Level: Level 7, Manager**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must have skills: Techno\-functional BA lead with eCommerce experience, CPQ or Pricing; independent client\-facing consulting; consultative selling; and team leadership**

**Good to have skills: Experience across multiple commerce, CPQ or pricing platforms,s pre\-sales, estimation and solution\-shaping exposure**

**Experience: 10\-15 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification**: **Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Commerce or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional certification is preferred**

**Job Summary**


You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled eCommerce, CPQ and pricing solutions. The role requires a consultative techno\-functional Business Analyst Manager who can independently lead client\-facing engagements, shape solutions and proposals, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and lead Business Analyst teams through clear requirements, delivery governance, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead the Business Analysis workstream across eCommerce, CPQ or Pricing delivery, with accountability for the BA strategy, team mobilization, requirements governance, quality standards and stakeholder alignment.
* Partner with client Product Owners, senior business sponsors, solution architects, sales and delivery leaders to shape scope, roadmap, commercial propositions and prioritization decisions.
* Lead executive and senior stakeholder workshops to frame business problems, define measurable outcomes, identify value levers and align on transformation and implementation approaches.
* Guide as\-is/to\-be process design, capability mapping, gap analysis, backlog strategy and release scoping across multiple functional areas.
* Direct, build and quality\-assure epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, functional specifications and decision records produced by the BA team.
* Identify solution options and make recommendations that balance business value, user experience, platform constraints, delivery risk and technical complexity.
* Own requirements traceability, change impact analysis and decision management across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release.
* Lead cross\-functional governance and delivery forums involving client business users, product owners, sales, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, data/integration and programme management.
* Own resolution and executive escalation of complex functional, delivery and scope issues, driving timely decisions and clear accountability.
* Lead estimation, staffing, transition planning, pre\-sales/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, reusable assets and practice/capability development as required.
* Operate as the Business Analysis Manager who independently represents the BA function to client executives, account leadership and delivery leadership.
* Own complex and ambiguous eCommerce problems, mobilize the right stakeholders and drive structured recommendations.
* Lead, coach and performance\-enable a team of Business Analysts; allocate work, review outputs, build capability and ensure consistency, quality and delivery readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders through consultative selling, value\-led storytelling, negotiation and clear recommendation of decision options.
* Contribute to account growth and delivery health by identifying opportunities, risks, dependencies, capability gaps and continuous improvement actions.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility, fulfilment and order status.
* Build trusted client relationships, identify follow\-on opportunities and collaborate with sales and solution teams to progress qualified opportunities.
* Be accountable for BA workstream plans, estimates, staffing needs, milestones, risks, dependencies and the quality of functional deliverables.
* Establish reusable methods, templates and quality gates, and contribute to hiring, mentoring and capability development for the Business Analysis practice.
* Strong techno\-functional understanding of APIs, webhooks, events, integrations, data flows, security, analytics and non\-functional requirements relevant to commerce, CPQ and pricing platforms.
* Ability to lead multiple capability areas across commerce journeys, product configuration, guided selling, quotation, approvals, pricing, promotions, order management, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs, lead fit\-gap analysis and guide business trade\-off decisions with client, architecture and delivery leaders.
* Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Business analysis leadership and requirements governance for complex digital commerce, CPQ or pricing programmes.
* Ability to lead multiple commerce capability areas across discovery, cart/checkout, order management, customer account, promotions, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess commerce platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs and guide business trade\-off decisions with architects and delivery leads.


Executive workshop facilitation, consultative selling, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, negotiation and requirements elicitation.


  

**Professional and Technical Skill**

* 10\-15 years of relevant experience, including leadership of complex client\-facing digital commerce, CPQ or pricing engagements
* Business analysis and requirements analysis for digital products or commerce platforms.
* User story writing, acceptance criteria definition and backlog refinement.
* Jira and Confluence proficiency; ability to maintain product backlog, decisions, traceability and release documentation.
* Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviews, process mapping and requirements elicitation.
* Ability to lead product owners, Business Analysts, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, release and client business stakeholders across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive\-level verbal and written communication for proposals, client presentations, solution pitches, demos, decisions and programme reporting.
* eCommerce domain knowledge across browse, search, PDP, cart, checkout, payments, promotions, order capture and order status.
* Techno\-functional understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics tagging, non\-functional requirements and platform constraints.
* Strong working knowledge of CPQ capabilities including product and bundle configuration, guided selling, quote creation, pricing, approvals, contracts and quote\-to\-cash touchpoints.
* Strong working knowledge of pricing capabilities including price strategy, segmentation, price books/lists, discounts, promotions, taxation, regional pricing, optimisation and price\-engine integrations.
* Experience with one or more relevant platforms such as SAP Commerce/Hybris, commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud/Revenue Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento, Shopify, PROS, Conga or similar is considered a plus.
* Understanding of SDLC phases including development, testing, deployment, maintenance and release governance.
* Relevant certification such as PSPO, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master, commerce platform, CPQ or pricing certification is preferred.
* Pricing domain knowledge including price books, price lists, promotions, discounts, taxation, regional pricing and price engine integrations.
* Working knowledge of delivery automation, version control, deployment strategies and DevOps collaboration sufficient to govern cross\-functional delivery.
* Search, merchandising, CMS, CDP, web analytics, payments, OMS or customer service platform exposure.
* PSPO I, PSPO II, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master or relevant commerce platform certifications.
* Exposure to headless commerce, composable commerce, microservices, event\-driven integrations or cloud\-native delivery.
* Experience with automation pipelines, version control, deployment strategies or DevOps collaboration.

title: Monitoring And Management Product Manager
description:
Location: Kochi
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: 16 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1743999
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Job title: Monitoring \& Management Product Manager**

  


**Job summary:**

  



The Monitoring \& Management Product Manager is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, governance, adoption and operational success of a global portfolio of vendor software platforms used to remotely monitor and manage audio visual (AV) and workplace technology devices. The role ensures these platforms provide reliable telemetry, actionable alerts, remote support capabilities and useful operational insights that improve service quality and the technology\-based office experience.

  



The Product Manager will work with Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Service Management, other product teams and technology vendors to translate business and operational needs into product capabilities. The role will guide platform selection and lifecycle decisions, establish support and governance models, drive integrations and automation, and measure the business value delivered by the portfolio.

  


**Key responsibilities (analytical/decision making/supervisory):**

  


* Own the global product strategy and multi\-year roadmap for AV telemetry, monitoring and remote management platforms.
* Lead proofs of concept and pilots; define success criteria, evaluate results and make evidence\-based recommendations for production adoption.
* Gather and prioritize requirements from Operations, Engineering, product teams and other stakeholders, balancing service value, effort, risk and cost.
* Manage the product lifecycle for assigned platforms, including evaluation, selection, onboarding, enhancement, integration, adoption, operational transition and retirement.
* Define platform standards for device onboarding, data consistency, health states, alerts, notifications, remote actions, and role\-based access.
* Drive integration with enterprise service management, event management, asset data, analytics and reporting capabilities to create and support automated workflows and improve leadership decision making.
* Establish service definitions for in\-scope platforms, ensure operational readiness requirements are met, integrate new platforms into PCD runbooks and Operations SOPs.
* Develop product KPIs and report on platform coverage, reliability, alert quality, adoption, automation, operational outcomes, cost and realized value.
* Ensure adequacy of on\-premise platform infrastructure, including server capacity, back\-up procedures, etc.
* Analyze telemetry and operational data to identify recurring issues, false positives, monitoring gaps and opportunities for proactive remediation or continuous improvement; collaborate with Operations to raise ITIL problems as appropriate.
* Manage strategic vendor relationships, licensing and service reviews; communicate EY requirements and influence vendor roadmaps.
* Prepare business cases, financial forecasts, investment recommendations and leadership updates for the product portfolio.
* Provide direction to internal teams, external suppliers and project resources delivering roadmap initiatives; the role may hold the “Sponsor’s Representative” role or coordinate work across teams without direct line\-management responsibility.
* Ensure platform decisions and changes are properly governed and align with EY security, privacy, compliance, architecture and operational resilience requirements.

  


**Knowledge, skills and experience requirements:**

  



To be successful in this role, candidates should exhibit the following core knowledge and skills:


* Strong product management experience in a global enterprise technology environment, including strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, lifecycle management and value realization.
* Experience managing software platforms for monitoring, observing and managing IoT endpoints, including unified communications, workplace technology or AV devices.
* Understanding of telemetry, events, device health, alerting, incident workflows, dashboards, APIs, data integration and management automation concepts.
* Ability to translate operational and technical requirements into clear product capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Experience developing on\-boarding and support processes and operational transition plans for enterprise platforms.
* Strong analytical and financial skills, including business\-case development, cost\-benefit analysis, forecasting and KPI definition.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships, influence decisions and gain consensus across diverse functions, cultures and geographies.
* Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly and concisely to engineering teams, operational stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Experience managing vendors, licensing, contracts, performance reviews and product evaluations.
* Knowledge of AV, Microsoft Teams Rooms, unified communications, collaboration technology or workplace technology is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Teams Pro Management Portal, Utelogy, Cisco Control Hub, Poly Lens, Jabra\+, Neat Pulse, Crestron XiO Cloud, Logitech Sync, ServiceNow, Netcool or Power BI is beneficial.
* Ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities and lead through ambiguity.
* Fluent written and spoken English; flexibility to participate in periodic early or late meetings with global stakeholders. Travel is expected to be limited.

  


**Qualifications, certifications and education requirements:**

  


* Successful candidates will have the specific role experience noted below:
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Typically 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in product management, IT operations, monitoring and management, unified communications, workplace technology or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience owning or significantly contributing to the lifecycle of enterprise software products or platforms used by global teams.
* Experience leading platform evaluations, proofs of concept, pilots and production deployments.
* Experience defining and tracking measurable business and operational outcomes for technology products.
* Product Management, ITIL, Agile, Scrum, SAFe or PMP certification is beneficial.
* AVIXA CTS or relevant Microsoft, Cisco or other collaboration technology certification is beneficial.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
